puertas.puerta: The user accepts the problem, the scope, and the current requirements before data or the backlog are designed.
The user accepts the data model and the stories before the backlog is extended or the architecture is closed.
The user accepts tasks, priorities, and architecture before an archetype is proposed.
The archetype canon requires confirmation of the blueprint. validar mode waits. continuo mode promotes it only when the pre-generation report has no blockers.
The remote, the branch, and explicit authorization are required, with the applicable checks green. No mode opens this gate by default.

prompt.modo_validar: Each gate stops the cycle. The board stays preliminary for the phases just generated.
prompt.modo_continuo: G1 through G4 count as granted only to continue inside the repository, with assumptions visible. G5 stays closed.

acciones_que_siempre_piden_autorizacion.accion: Push, force push, rewriting published history, or deleting a branch.
A destructive migration, deleting data, or rotating secrets.
Changing a critical structure outside the requested scope.
Replacing a current document the user already edited.
